1. It Works When The Power Grid Goes Down

When the grid fails, the pumps stop and the tap runs dry within hours. Aqua-GS1 does not care. It runs on gravity alone. No power, no batteries, no pumping. It keeps making clean water in the exact moment everyone else is scrambling.

2. It Turns Any Creek, Pond Or Rainwater Into Safe Drinking Water

You are almost never truly out of water. Streams, ponds, lakes, and rain are all around you. The problem is what is in it. Aqua-GS1 turns that water into safe drinking water, so you drink what is already there instead of rationing a few bottles in the garage.

3. It Removes 99.9% Of Bacteria And Parasites

Untreated water carries E. coli, giardia, and cryptosporidium. One swallow can put you flat on your back. The 0.1-micron hollow-fiber core is a physical wall those bacteria and parasites simply cannot cross. It removes 99.9% of them. That is protection, not just filtration.

Fill the bag. Hang it from a branch or a hook. Walk away. Gravity pulls the water through the filter while you handle everything else. Clean water pours out the bottom on its own. One gallon at a time, completely hands-free, for the whole family.

One filter cleans up to 1,500 gallons. That is enough clean water to carry a family through months of emergencies, not just an afternoon. One Aqua-GS1 replaces thousands of single-use bottles.

7. It Packs Down To Just 6 Ounces

Empty, it weighs about six ounces and folds flat. It slips into any bug-out bag, glovebox, or kitchen drawer. It is there the moment you reach for it, and you forget it is there until the day you need it.
